Website information

Privacy policy.

A concise explanation of how this static institutional website handles enquiries and external links.

Effective for this published site

Information you choose to share.

This website does not store admissions enquiries on the site itself. When you complete the enquiry form, it validates the required fields and prepares a message in your own email application addressed to the admissions office.

Contact actions

Phone, email, WhatsApp, map and social links open the external service you select. Those services handle information according to their own policies.

Media and downloads

Photographs, video and the prospectus are published as institutional resources. Downloading a file or opening an external link is initiated by you.

Questions

For questions about an enquiry or the information published here, contact admission@newanmolgroupofinstitutions.co.in or call +91 7906208195.
